articles.title: King of Prussia data center complex is rejected by Upper Merion Township officials
articles.summary: Main Line developer Brian O'Neill wants to build a nearly 5-million-square-foot data center campus over five properties. The board of supervisors denied the plan, a decision the developer can appeal.

articles.title: King of Prussia data center fight could be paused by developer’s lawsuit
articles.summary: Upper Merion Township had been set to vote this week on Brian O'Neill's proposed 5-million-square-foot data center campus. Now, a decision is on hold.

articles.title: Charter Senior Living Breaks Ground on 162-Unit Project in West Chester, Pennsylvania
articles.summary: WEST CHESTER, PA. — Charter Senior Living has broken ground on a 162-unit project in West Chester, located roughly 30 miles west of Philadelphia. Charter Senior Living of West Chester will offer independent living, assisted living and memory care residences. Charter is developing the project in partnership with Paradise Management. Completion is scheduled for late next year. The post Charter Senior Living Breaks Ground on 162-Unit Project in West Chester, Pennsylvania appeared first on REBusines

articles.title: Tyson Foods launches ride sharing program at its Lancaster County complex
articles.summary: Tyson Foods, just outside New Holland in Earl Township, has launched a ride-share program to address transportation barriers among current workers and attract prospective ones through a partnership with Enterprise, a car rental company.

articles.title: 'It's really all I wanted to do': workers at former R.R. Donnelley plants mourn closure

articles.title: Redevelopment of the former St. Joseph Hospital gets $1.5 million grant from the state
